body.en: Your brand is more than just a logo—it’s a personality. We work closely with you to uncover your brand’s core attributes and transform them into a visual language that truly resonates. Through color palettes, type choices, iconography, and more, we ensure every visual detail reflects your mission and tone. This process gives your audience an immediate sense of who you are and what you stand for, helping you stand out in even the most crowded markets and make lasting impressions from the very first glance.
body.zh: 品牌不只是一个标志，更是一种个性。我们与你一起发掘品牌的核心特质，并将它转化为令人共鸣的视觉语言。从配色、字体到图形，每个细节都回应品牌的使命与语气，让受众迅速理解你是谁、坚持什么，在拥挤的市场中留下深刻的第一印象。

body.en: We don’t just design logos—we craft memorable symbols that anchor your entire brand identity. Our logo design process includes research, sketches, refinement, and multiple variations to ensure adaptability across every platform and format. Whether it’s on a business card, app icon, or giant banner, your logo will always hold its integrity and visual clarity. Beyond aesthetics, we focus on meaning—shaping visuals that tell your story at a glance and set the tone for the entire brand experience. Your logo becomes your visual handshake, and we make sure it’s a confident one.
body.zh: 我们打造的不是孤立的图形，而是整套品牌识别的核心。通过研究、草图、反复优化和多种版本，让标志适用于名片、应用图标和大型展示，同时保持清晰与完整。我们也关注视觉背后的含义，让它能够讲述品牌故事，成为一次自信的视觉握手。

body.en: Inconsistent branding confuses your audience and weakens trust. That’s why we design every element with repeatability and versatility in mind. Whether you need assets for social media, email campaigns, pitch decks, or print materials, our design system ensures your brand looks and feels the same across every medium. We also offer templates and guidelines to keep things streamlined as your business grows. With every touchpoint aligned, you create a seamless customer journey that feels intentional, cohesive, and professional—building confidence with your audience at every step.
body.zh: 不一致的视觉会让受众困惑，也会削弱信任。我们从可复用与适应性出发，为社交媒体、邮件、提案和印刷物建立统一的设计系统，并提供模板与指南。每个触点保持协调，让客户旅程连贯、专业，在企业成长过程中持续建立信心。

body.en: We equip you with an easy-to-follow brand style guide that covers all key visual elements: logo usage, color codes, typography rules, spacing, tone, and imagery styles. This document is tailored for both designers and non-designers, so whether it’s a new team member or an external partner, everyone knows exactly how to keep your brand looking sharp. These guidelines act as your brand’s compass—ensuring visual consistency, reducing confusion, and speeding up future design work. It’s not just a file—it’s a long-term asset that protects and elevates your brand over time.
body.zh: 我们提供清晰的品牌风格指南，涵盖标志用法、颜色代码、字体、留白、语气和图片风格。设计师、团队新人和外部合作伙伴都能轻松使用，让后续设计更高效，减少沟通歧义。这份长期资产将保护品牌的一致性，并帮助品牌持续成长。

body.en: Graphic design is more than decoration—it’s storytelling. We create visuals that communicate your message clearly and compellingly, whether it’s a social media post, digital ad, brochure, or presentation. Every piece we design is rooted in strategy and aligned with your brand identity. We focus on layout, typography, color, and hierarchy to guide the viewer’s eye and leave a lasting impression. Our goal is to turn ideas into impactful visuals that resonate with your audience and drive engagement, helping your brand speak volumes—without saying a word.
body.zh: 平面设计不仅是装饰，更是叙事。无论社交帖子、数字广告、手册还是演示文稿，我们都用清晰而有感染力的视觉传递信息。每一份设计都以策略为基础，与品牌识别保持一致，通过布局、字体、颜色与层次引导视线，把想法转化为能与受众产生共鸣、促进互动的作品。

body.en: From print to pixels, we design for wherever your audience is. Need a banner for an event, a carousel for Instagram, or a sleek deck for investors? We’ve got it covered. Our team adapts your designs for each platform and format, ensuring every piece looks intentional and performs its purpose—whether it’s to inform, inspire, or convert. We take care of all the technical specs too, so you’ll never worry about resolution, file types, or guidelines. Just tell us what you need and we’ll deliver it, on-brand and on time.
body.zh: 从印刷品到数字屏幕，我们在受众出现的每个平台提供适合的设计：活动横幅、社交轮播或投资者演示。根据不同平台和格式调整作品，兼顾传达、启发与转化的目标，并处理分辨率、文件格式及平台规范。只需告诉我们需求，就能按时获得符合品牌的设计。

body.en: We specialize in marketing design that doesn’t just look good—it drives results. Our design process is conversion-focused, whether it’s a lead magnet, digital ad, or email campaign. We work with your goals in mind and structure each design to guide users toward action. With clear messaging, smart layouts, and attention-grabbing visuals, we help turn scrolls into clicks and clicks into customers. Good design builds trust. Great design drives growth—and we’re here to deliver the latter consistently.
body.zh: 营销设计既要好看，也要带来结果。无论获客资料、数字广告还是邮件活动，我们始终围绕业务目标，设计清晰的信息、合理的布局和吸引注意的视觉，引导用户采取行动。让浏览变成点击，让点击变成客户，以持续而出色的设计建立信任并推动增长。

body.en: Need design support on the fly? Our subscription model means you have a professional design team at your fingertips—no need to chase freelancers or juggle contracts. Submit unlimited design requests, prioritize what matters most, and receive quick turnarounds on everything. Whether it’s one-off graphics or a steady stream of visuals, we adapt to your workflow and scale with your needs. It’s like having your own in-house team, without the overhead.
body.zh: 通过订阅，你随时拥有专业设计团队，无需反复寻找自由职业者或协调合同。不限次数提交需求，确定优先级，快速获取成果。从单次图形到持续的内容生产，我们适应你的工作方式，随业务需求扩展，像内部团队一样协作，同时减少管理成本。

body.en: Framer brings websites to life with built-in interactions and smooth animations. We leverage this power to create immersive experiences that feel dynamic, modern, and engaging. Every page we design in Framer doesn’t just look good—it moves with purpose. From subtle hover effects to scroll-triggered animations, we craft micro-interactions that enhance user experience without overwhelming the message. The result? Websites that feel alive, intuitive, and perfectly aligned with your brand.
body.zh: Framer 的内置交互与流畅动画让网站鲜活起来。我们利用这些能力构建现代、动态且投入感强的体验。每个动作都有明确目的：从细微的悬浮反馈到滚动触发动画，在增强用户体验的同时不喧宾夺主。网站既生动直觉，又与品牌保持一致。

body.en: Framer’s collaborative environment lets us design and prototype in the same place—meaning faster feedback loops and fewer handoffs. You’ll be able to follow progress in real time, leave comments directly in the project, and even preview responsive designs instantly. This makes communication seamless and iterations lightning fast. With less back and forth and more doing, we keep your projects moving and your timelines on track.
body.zh: 在同一个 Framer 环境中完成设计与原型，减少交接，加快反馈。你可以实时查看进展，在项目中直接评论，并即时预览响应式效果。顺畅的沟通让迭代更快，减少反复传递文件，把更多时间投入真正的设计工作，确保项目按计划推进。

body.en: Framer isn’t just a design tool—it’s a launchpad. We build fully functional, responsive websites directly within Framer, ready to publish in just a few clicks. No need to export to code or involve developers. From marketing sites to personal portfolios, your site is designed and developed in one place—pixel-perfect, SEO-ready, and fully hosted. We’ll handle every step from layout to launch so you can focus on running your business.
body.zh: Framer 不只是设计工具，也是网站发布平台。我们直接在其中构建功能完整的响应式网站，几次点击即可发布，无需导出代码或额外开发。从营销官网到个人作品集，设计与实现集中完成，兼顾像素精度、搜索优化与托管。我们负责布局到上线的过程，让你专注业务。

body.en: Once your Framer site is live, updating it is a breeze. Whether it’s swapping out images, tweaking text, or adding new pages, the intuitive interface makes edits quick and simple—no coding required. We also provide documentation and support so your team can manage content confidently. If you ever need ongoing help, we’re here. You get the freedom of a no-code platform with the backup of a professional design team.
body.zh: 网站上线后，更换图片、修改文字和添加页面都可以在直观界面中完成，无需编码。我们提供文档和支持，让团队能够自信管理内容。需要持续帮助时，专业设计团队也随时提供支持，让无代码平台的灵活性与专业协作兼得。

body.en: We don’t just make websites look good—we design them to perform. Every layout, button, and section is crafted with your business goals in mind. Whether it’s generating leads, boosting sales, or telling your story, we focus on user experience and conversion strategy. We map out clear user flows, use proven design patterns, and guide your visitors toward action. The result? A site that not only reflects your brand beautifully but also drives real results.
body.zh: 我们让网站既好看，也真正有效。每个布局、按钮和区块都围绕业务目标：获取线索、促进销售或讲述品牌故事。我们梳理清晰的用户流程，采用经过验证的设计模式，引导访客采取行动，在准确展现品牌的同时带来实际成果。

body.en: Your website should feel unmistakably you . We take the time to understand your voice, values, and vision—then translate it into a custom design that’s unique, cohesive, and instantly recognizable. From colors and typography to layout and imagery, every detail is tailored to your brand. No cookie-cutter templates. Just thoughtful design that speaks to your audience and sets you apart in a crowded digital space.
body.zh: 你的网站应有独特而鲜明的品牌个性。我们先了解品牌语气、价值与愿景，再转化为定制且连贯的设计。从配色、字体到布局与图片，每个细节都贴合品牌。我们以认真思考的设计与受众对话，帮助品牌在拥挤的数字空间中脱颖而出。

body.en: Your visitors are on the go—and your website needs to keep up. We design with a mobile-first mindset, ensuring your site looks flawless and functions smoothly across all devices and screen sizes. Whether it’s a phone, tablet, or desktop, your users will get a seamless experience that’s fast, accessible, and easy to navigate. This not only improves engagement but also boosts your SEO and overall professionalism.
body.zh: 访客随时可能通过手机访问网站。我们采用移动优先设计，确保手机、平板和桌面都拥有清晰的视觉与顺畅的功能。快速、易用、无障碍且导航清晰的体验，不仅提升参与度，也有助于搜索表现和整体专业形象。

body.en: As your business grows, your website should grow with it. We build flexible design systems and scalable layouts that make it easy to add new content, pages, or features in the future. Whether you’re just starting out or managing a growing brand, our web designs are future-proof and ready to evolve with you—without needing a full redesign every time something changes.
body.zh: 业务成长时，网站也应能够一起成长。灵活的设计系统和可扩展布局，让后续增加内容、页面与功能更加轻松。无论刚起步还是持续扩张，网站都能跟随品牌演进，减少每次变化都需要全面重做的负担。

body.en: We completely overhauled GreenTech's website with a modern, clean design that aligned with their innovative products. The new design helped to reflect their cutting-edge technology and improve overall user experience.
body.zh: 我们重新设计了 GreenTech 的网站，以现代、简洁的视觉呼应创新产品，展现其前沿技术，并改善整体用户体验。

body.en: The navigation and user journey were optimized to guide visitors seamlessly to product pages and contact forms. This resulted in a smoother experience and a significant drop in bounce rates.
body.zh: 我们优化导航与用户旅程，顺畅引导访客访问产品和联系表单，降低跳出率，让体验更加连贯。

body.en: By focusing on conversion-driven design elements like clear calls to action and optimized landing pages, we saw a 25% increase in sign-ups for their services within the first month.
body.zh: 通过清晰的行动入口和优化的落地页，上线首月服务注册量提升了 25%。

body.en: Following the launch, we continued working with GreenTech to fine-tune their site, incorporate user feedback, and implement A/B testing for further optimization. The partnership allowed for consistent growth and adaptation to their audience's needs.
body.zh: 上线后继续收集用户反馈、微调网站并开展 A/B 测试，帮助平台适应受众需求，实现持续增长。

body.en: We reimagined the HealthSync platform, focusing on an intuitive, user-friendly design. The new layout simplified navigation, allowing users to easily access medical services and schedule appointments.
body.zh: 我们以直觉友好的设计重新梳理 HealthSync 平台。简化布局与导航，让用户能够轻松找到医疗服务并预约。

body.en: We integrated a seamless appointment booking system that enabled users to book consultations with just a few clicks, significantly improving user satisfaction and reducing drop-off rates.
body.zh: 集成顺畅的预约系统，用户只需几次点击即可预订咨询，提高满意度并减少中途放弃。

body.en: With mobile access being critical for HealthSync’s users, we optimized the platform for mobile responsiveness, ensuring it provided a smooth experience on all devices. This led to increased mobile engagement.
body.zh: 针对用户的重要移动使用场景优化响应式表现，确保不同设备上的体验顺畅，提升移动端参与度。

body.en: After the website launch, we continued working with HealthSync, implementing new features and ongoing user testing. Regular updates allowed for improvements based on feedback and kept the platform ahead of user expectations.
body.zh: 上线后持续加入新功能并进行用户测试，根据反馈定期更新，让平台跟上用户期待。

body.en: We redesigned EcoBrands’ website with a focus on modern aesthetics and user-centric design. The site now showcases their eco-friendly products in a clear, attractive way, leading to higher engagement and interaction.
body.zh: 围绕现代美感和以用户为中心的设计，重新打造 EcoBrands 网站，清晰展示环保产品，提升参与和互动。

body.en: We refined EcoBrands' messaging and visual identity to align with their sustainability mission. The new design effectively communicates their values and mission, fostering a stronger connection with their audience.
body.zh: 调整文案和视觉识别，使其与可持续发展的使命保持一致。新的设计清晰传达品牌价值，与受众建立更紧密的联系。

body.en: We implemented conversion-focused design elements like strategically placed CTAs and optimized landing pages. This led to a noticeable uptick in product purchases and newsletter sign-ups.
body.zh: 通过策略性布置行动入口与优化落地页，提高产品购买与邮件订阅转化。

body.en: Post-launch, we continued supporting EcoBrands with design updates and seasonal campaigns to ensure the website remains fresh and aligned with new products, keeping the site relevant and engaging for returning visitors.
body.zh: 上线后继续支持设计更新和季节营销，让网站与新品保持同步，为回访用户提供新鲜内容。

body.en: We gave FitnessPro's website a complete makeover with a fresh, modern design that emphasizes their fitness programs. The clean, dynamic layout makes it easier for users to find what they need and engage with the content.
body.zh: 我们为 FitnessPro 打造现代清晰的全新网站，突出健身项目，让用户更容易找到所需信息并与内容互动。

body.en: We integrated a custom class booking system that allowed members to easily view and book available sessions. The system improved scheduling efficiency and reduced manual errors, enhancing user satisfaction.
body.zh: 定制课程预订系统，让会员方便地查看和预约课程。提高排期效率，减少人工错误，提升使用满意度。

body.en: Understanding the mobile-first approach, we optimized the website for mobile users, providing a seamless experience across devices. This resulted in increased engagement, particularly among users booking classes on their smartphones.
body.zh: 采用移动优先设计，保证跨设备的流畅体验，特别改善用户通过手机预约课程时的参与度。

body.en: After the launch, we continued working with FitnessPro to tweak design elements based on feedback and user analytics. We ensured that updates were implemented quickly to keep the platform optimized for user needs.
body.zh: 根据反馈和使用数据微调设计，快速落实更新，让平台持续符合用户需求。

body.en: We redesigned the Urban Apparel website to focus on a clean, visually appealing layout that highlights their products. The design makes shopping easier by emphasizing featured collections and streamlining the product discovery process.
body.zh: 以简洁而有吸引力的布局突出 Urban Apparel 产品。强调精选系列，优化商品发现过程，让购物更轻松。

body.en: We implemented advanced filtering and search functionalities, making it easier for customers to browse products based on categories, colors, sizes, and more. This change significantly improved product findability and resulted in increased user engagement.
body.zh: 加入按分类、颜色、尺寸等维度的筛选与搜索功能，帮助顾客更快找到商品，提升参与度。

body.en: We introduced optimized product pages, with high-quality images, customer reviews, and clear calls to action. This enhanced the shopping experience, leading to a 40% increase in sales and improved customer retention rates.
body.zh: 通过高质量图片、顾客评价和清晰行动入口优化商品页面，推动销售提升 40%，并改善客户留存。

body.en: After the website launch, we continued optimizing the site with A/B testing on product pages and promotions. Regular updates helped maintain customer interest and ensured that the website stayed aligned with current trends and marketing campaigns.
body.zh: 上线后对商品页和促销活动持续开展 A/B 测试，定期更新以保持用户兴趣，并响应市场趋势与营销活动。

body.en: We completely revamped the BrightMinds Academy website, focusing on a clean, professional design that reflects their educational values. The new layout made it easier for students to navigate the courses and access educational resources.
body.zh: 重新设计 BrightMinds Academy 网站，用简洁专业的界面体现教育价值，让学员更容易浏览课程和获取学习资源。

body.en: We introduced advanced course filtering and a search functionality that allowed prospective students to easily find the courses that fit their needs. This enhanced discovery led to a significant uptick in course registrations.
body.zh: 加入课程筛选与搜索，让潜在学员快速找到适合自己的课程，显著提升报名量。

body.en: The new website design focused on improving the user experience by ensuring the interface was intuitive and easy to use. With streamlined navigation and better calls to action, students could register for courses with minimal friction.
body.zh: 通过直观易用的界面、精简导航与清晰行动入口，减少学员注册课程时的操作阻力。

body.en: Post-launch, we worked with BrightMinds Academy to refine the website’s features, implement user feedback, and introduce new functionalities like student progress tracking. This ensured their platform continued to evolve in line with user needs.
body.zh: 上线后根据用户反馈完善功能，并加入学习进度跟踪等新能力，让平台持续适应用户需求。

title.en: This is a fictional Privacy Policy page
title.zh: 本页为虚构的隐私政策示例

body.en: At {{brand}}, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.
body.zh: 此政策示例说明 {{brand}} 如何收集、使用和保护访问网站及使用服务时的个人信息。本模板不提供真实账户、支付、营销或数据处理服务，联系表单只做本地校验，不发送或保存信息。

body.en: We collect personal information such as your name, email address, and payment details when you use our services. We also collect information about your usage of our website through cookies.
body.zh: 示例业务可能在提供服务时收集姓名、邮箱、支付信息，以及通过 Cookie 获取网站使用信息。

body.en: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you, and process payments. We may also use it to send you marketing materials if you opt-in.
body.zh: 信息可用于提供和改进服务、沟通、处理付款；经选择同意后，也可用于发送营销资料。

body.en: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with trusted third-party providers who assist us in delivering our services or when required by law.
body.zh: 不出售个人信息。可能与帮助交付服务的可信第三方共享信息，或依法披露。

body.en: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information, but no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We recommend that you take appropriate steps to safeguard your data.
body.zh: 我们采取合理措施保护个人信息，但互联网传输无法保证绝对安全，建议用户也采取适当措施保护数据。

body.en: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can also opt out of receiving marketing communications at any time.
body.zh: 你可以申请访问、更正或删除个人信息，并随时退出营销通信。

body.en: We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
body.zh: Cookie 可用于改善体验，你可以通过浏览器设置管理 Cookie 偏好。

body.en: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective Date."
body.zh: 政策可能不时更新。变更会在本页公布，并注明新的生效日期。

title.en: This is a fictional Cookie Policy page
title.zh: 本页为虚构的 Cookie 政策示例

body.en: This Cookie Policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our website. It describes the types of cookies we use and why we use them.
body.zh: 本示例介绍网站如何使用 Cookie 等技术识别访客，以及 Cookie 的类型和用途。本模板没有集成分析、广告或营销 Cookie。

body.en: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your actions and preferences over time.
body.zh: Cookie 是访问网站时保存在设备上的小型文本文件，让网站在一段时间内记住操作与偏好。

body.en: We use cookies to improve the performance of our website, personalize content and ads, provide social media features, and analyze our traffic. By continuing to use our site, you consent to our use of cookies.
body.zh: 真实业务网站可能使用 Cookie 改善性能、个性化内容与广告、提供社交功能及分析流量，具体使用需遵循适用法律及有效同意。

body.en: You can control the use of cookies through your browser settings. You can block or delete cookies, but please note that some website features may not function properly without them.
body.zh: 你可以在浏览器设置中控制、阻止或删除 Cookie。禁用后，部分网站功能可能无法正常使用。

body.en: We may update our Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page, with an updated "Last update".
body.zh: 政策可能不时更新，变更会在本页公布，并同步最近更新时间。

title.en: This is a fictional Term of Service page
title.zh: 本页为虚构的服务条款示例

body.en: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of {{brand}}’s website and services. By accessing or using our website, you agree to comply with these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use our services.
body.zh: 本示例说明 {{brand}} 网站与服务的使用规则，正式业务应另行提供适用条款。本模板没有真实账户、订阅或付款功能，不构成服务购买合同。

body.en: By accessing or using our website or services, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you are using our services on behalf of a company or other organization, you represent that you have the authority to bind that organization to these Terms.
body.zh: 使用真实业务网站或服务时，应遵循其有效条款。代表组织使用服务时，应确保具有约束该组织的授权。

body.en: {{brand}} provides web design services through a subscription model. The details of these services, including pricing and scope, are outlined on our website and may be updated periodically.
body.zh: {{brand}} 通过订阅模式提供网站设计服务。服务范围与价格由网站说明，并可能定期更新。

body.en: To use certain features of our services, you may be required to create an account. You agree to provide accurate, complete, and up-to-date information during the registration process. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password.
body.zh: 部分真实服务可能要求注册账户。用户应提供准确、完整且最新的信息，并妥善保管账户与密码。

body.en: You agree to use our services in a lawful manner and not to engage in any conduct that may harm the functionality, security, or reputation of our website or services. You may not attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of our website or services.
body.zh: 应合法使用服务，不得损害网站或服务的功能、安全与声誉，也不得尝试未经授权的访问。

body.en: Our subscription plans are billed on a monthly or annual basis. You agree to pay the applicable fees as described in the pricing section of our website. Payments are non-refundable except as required by law.
body.zh: 示例订阅可按月或按年计费。费用和退款条件应以实际业务条款及适用法律为准。

body.en: You may cancel your subscription at any time by following the cancellation process outlined on our website. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the website and services if we determine you have violated these Terms.
body.zh: 真实业务应提供订阅取消流程；违反有效条款时，服务提供者可能暂停或终止访问。
